legend.transitAccess.cmpDirection: Negative = GPS version faster (timetable underestimates); positive = GPS slower (timetable overestimates)
legend.transitAccess.cmpSpreadMissing: One version unreachable at P5 or P95 within 120 min
legend.transitAccess.cmpOnlyOne: Cells reachable in only one version use the darkest class
legend.transitAccess.spreadNote: P95−P5: spread of travel time across departure minutes; larger = more affected by waiting. P95 unreachable uses the brightest class
legend.transitAccess.ratioDirection: Orange = transit competitive (low ratio); purple = driving much faster
legend.transitAccess.tierRule: {pct}: viable = ≤ {a} min; car-dependent = > {b} min, unreachable, or > {a} min with transit÷car > {r}; otherwise marginal
legend.transitAccess.carPeak: Car baseline: free-flow ÷{f} (peak factor, estimated) + {ovh} min
legend.transitAccess.tierAssumption: Thresholds are assumptions and adjustable in the panel; shares are sensitive to the car baseline
legend.transitAccess.nightNote: Share of departure minutes in the window that reach the nearest facility within {T} min (lower bound from 5 percentiles)
legend.transitAccess.noSlot: No results for this time slot and version yet
legend.transitAccess.cmpFallback: Comparison supports nearest time, wait uncertainty and tiers only; showing nearest-time difference
legend.transitAccess.schedV1: The timetable version still uses the pre-fix v1 schedule (e.g. early last return trips); will be updated after recomputation
legend.transitAccess.gridCaliber: Scenario model, not measured: TDX timetables + GPS-derived bus trips, transit + walking (≤15 min per leg); about 10 min error per cell vs route planners, read magnitudes only; outside Taipei/New Taipei not covered
legend.transitAccess.steps: Scale 0–{h} h: 15-min steps for the first 2 h, then 30-min
legend.transitAccess.playbackCaliber: Scenario model, not measured: travel-time percentiles over departures every minute; cells unreachable within 240 min not drawn; outside Taipei/New Taipei not covered
